decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the completion of the works.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north and south walls of the garage hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The garage shown on drawing 0090-02-Rev A shall not be used for any other purpose than for the parking of vehicles or storage or other uses incidental to the enjoyment  of the dwellinghouse, in relation to the residential use of 27 Temple Road Hounslow

Condition : 6 - Before the development commences, details of a vehicular crossover of 3.6m width, to access the garage hereby approved, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
description: ERECTION OF A DETACHED SINGLE-STOREY GARAGE TO REAR OF DWELLINGHOUSE
